spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-UNI-003] SHARED OPERATOR UX INVARIANTS. Across all task modes: ONE selection model (`StudioSelectionSet` regardless of raster/vector/layout context), ONE undo/history surface (14.19), ONE color pipeline (14.8), ONE asset/library surface (Loom is the home for brushes, styles, palettes, components, export recipes, and placed assets — no Studio-private asset silo), and ONE export surface (`StudioExportRecipe`, 14.13).

[STU-UNI-001] ONE DOCUMENT, ONE TOOL SURFACE. Studio presents one unified `StudioDocument` model and one unified tool surface across raster/vector/layout/design-system/whiteboard domains. There are no per-source-app silos: a shared capability exists once as a Studio primitive (14.3) and every operator-facing tool/panel/command is a projection of that single primitive — the same typed contract models call (14.16).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.

scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-UNI-003] SHARED OPERATOR UX INVARIANTS. Across all task modes: ONE selection model (`StudioSelectionSet` regardless of raster/vector/layout context), ONE undo/history surface (14.19), ONE color pipeline (14.8), ONE asset/library surface (Loom is the home for brushes, styles, palettes, components, export recipes, and placed assets — no Studio-private asset silo), and ONE export surface (`StudioExportRecipe`, 14.13).

scope_basis.heading: ## 14.21 Operator Unification Surface
scope_basis.verbatim: [STU-UNI-001] ONE DOCUMENT, ONE TOOL SURFACE. Studio presents one unified `StudioDocument` model and one unified tool surface across raster/vector/layout/design-system/whiteboard domains. There are no per-source-app silos: a shared capability exists once as a Studio primitive (14.3) and every operator-facing tool/panel/command is a projection of that single primitive — the same typed contract models call (14.16).
